_doc: FluentCommunity vendor-map per PRINCIPLES-VENDOR.md V11. One row per touched ability. Populated incrementally as fix packages land.

abilities.notes: Package 3 V2 canonical namespace fix. Prior registrar called Space::create(['type'=>'course']); the BaseSpace::boot creating hook reads the model's static $type property, so Space (static $type='community') overwrote the passed type and persisted type=community — causing all downstream course/lesson/enrollment reads to return 'Course not found' (7 cascade failures). Course model (static $type='course') uses the same hook correctly. Slug uniqueness check still uses Space::withoutGlobalScopes() to detect conflicts across all space types (community/course/sidebar_link share the slug-unique constraint on fcom_spaces).
Package 3 V2 canonical namespace fix (cascade of create-course fix). Uses Course model which has a type=course global scope, replacing the legacy Space::where('type','course') pattern.
